beliefs: Only the first character of a string is transformed; the rest is copied unchanged (abc→cbc, bcd→dcd, Hello→Jello) [E3, E4, E5]
Lowercase ASCII letters are shifted forward by 2 with wrap-around (a→c, z→b) [E2, E3, E6]
Uppercase ASCII letters are shifted forward by 2 with wrap-around (A→C, Z→B) [E1, E3, E6, E7]
Digits, punctuation, and non-space symbols are left unchanged [E1, E4, E5, E7]
A leading space is NOT stripped; a string starting with a space is left entirely unchanged [E7, E8, E9, E10, E11, E13, E14]
The empty string maps to itself [E7]
Non-ASCII letters (Latin-1 accented, Greek, CJK, etc.) are shifted forward by 2 in their code point, i.e. chr(ord(c)+2) [E15]
